name: Tsunomon
text: [On Deletion] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait from your trash to the hand.

name: Gomamon
text: [All Turns] Your opponent can't gain memory other than by Tamer effects.

name: Ikkakumon
text: [Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost.[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the top 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards can't attack or block until their turn ends.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] If you have 7 or fewer cards in your hand, ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.)

name: Zudomon
text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] For every 2 colors your Tamers have, trash any 1 of your opponent's Digimon's digivolution cards. Then, return 1 of their Digimon with 1 or fewer digivolution cards to the hand.[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Alliance＞ for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
＜Alliance＞ (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

name: Angemon
text: [When Digivolving] If you have 1 or fewer Tamers, you may play 1 Tamer card with the [ADVENTURE] trait from your hand without paying the cost.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -2000 DP for the turn.

name: MagnaAngemon
text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Place 1 of your opponent's 6000 DP or lower Digimon as the top security card. For every 2 colors your Tamers have, add 2000 to this effect's DP maximum.[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Alliance＞ for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
＜Alliance＞ (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

name: Palmon
text: [On Play] By trashing 1 card with the [ADVENTURE] trait in your hand, ＜Draw 2＞. (Draw 2 cards from your deck.)

name: Togemon
text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] If your Tamers with the [ADVENTURE] trait have 3 or more total colors, this Digimon may digivolve into a Digimon card with the [ADVENTURE] trait in the hand without paying the cost.

name: Lillymon
text: [On Play] [When Digivolving] Suspend all of your opponent's 5000 DP or lower Digimon. Then, for every 2 colors your Tamers have, return 1 of their suspended Digimon to the bottom of the deck.[Your Turn] [Once Per Turn] When your other Digimon are played or digivolve, if any of them have the [ADVENTURE] trait, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Alliance＞ for the turn. Then, 1 of your Digimon may attack.
＜Alliance＞ (When this Digimon attacks, by suspending 1 of your other Digimon, this Digimon gains ＜Security A. +1＞ and the suspended Digimon's DP for the attack.)

name: Gabumon
text: [Your Turn] While your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, or your Tamers have 3 or more total colors, this Digimon can digivolve into [MetalGarurumon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.
[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] ＜Draw 1＞. (Draw 1 card from your deck.) Then, trash 1 card in your hand.

name: Gabumon
text: [Your Turn] While your opponent has a Digimon with 10000 DP or more, or your Tamers have 3 or more total colors, this Digimon can digivolve into [MetalGarurumon] in the hand for a digivolution cost of 4, ignoring digivolution requirements.

name: MetalGarurumon ACE
text: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)[On Play] [When Digivolving] Return 1 of your opponent's level 4 or lower Digimon to the bottom of the deck. For every 2 colors your Tamers have, add 1 to this effect's level maximum.[When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] You may play 1 level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)

name: Joe Kido & Mimi Tachikawa
text: [Start of Your Main Phase] If you have a Digimon with the [ADVENTURE] trait, gain 1 memory.[Your Turn] When any Digimon cards with the [ADVENTURE] trait would be played from your hand, by suspending this Tamer, reduce the play cost by 1.
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

name: Matt Ishida & T.K. Takaishi
text: [Your Turn] When any Digimon cards with the [ADVENTURE] trait would be played from your hand, by suspending this Tamer, reduce the play cost by 1.[Your Turn] All of your level 5 or higher Digimon with the [ADVENTURE] trait gain ＜Rush＞. (This Digimon can attack the turn it was played.)
[Security] Play this card without paying the cost.

name: Believe in Our Friendship
text: While you have a Digimon or Tamer with the [ADVENTURE] trait on the field, you can ignore this card's color requirements.[Main] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [ADVENTURE] trait among them to the hand. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck. Then, place this card in the battle area.[Main] ＜Delay＞ (By trashing this card after the placing turn, activate the effect.)・Gain 2 memory.
[Security] Place this card in the battle area.

name: Gennai's House
text: While you have no face-up [Gennai's House] security cards, you can ignore this card's color requirements.[Security] [Your Turn] All of your level 3 or higher Digimon get +3000 DP.[Main] Add your bottom security card to the hand. Then, place this card face up as the bottom security card.
[Security] You may play 1 level 3 Digimon card from your trash without paying the cost.
